intro: Ayanna Everstride is a kaldorei hunter trainer stationed in Aldrassil within the Shadowglen of Teldrassil. She instructs fledgling night elf rangers in the foundational arts of marksmanship, tracking, and wilderness survival. Young hunters taking their first steps beneath the boughs of the World Tree seek her guidance to hone their woodland discipline.

p: Perched inside Aldrassil at the very heart of the Shadowglen, Ayanna Everstride stands ready to instruct newly awakened kaldorei in the ways of the wild. To the night elves, a hunter is not merely a trapper or sharpshooter, but an indispensable guardian of the sacred forests. Ayanna provides guidance on early martial techniques, helping novices master ranged combat and survive in the perilous woods of Teldrassil.
